provenance.source: mainnet Market accounts with the store program's get_market_status and get_market_token_price simulated at their slot (8af1e70c), Arbitrum keeper prices through the mint table, and @gmsol-labs/gmsol-sdk 0.9.0-test.2 MarketStatus funding at the same clock; the two 'at index price' entries run the views at a shifted index price so the trader pnl cap binds
mainnet Market accounts, GMTrade keeper prices and @gmsol-labs/gmsol-sdk 0.9.0 MarketStatus at one second

mainnet Position accounts of store CTDLvGGXnoxvqLyTpGzdGLg9pD6JexKxKXSV8tqqo8bN with their Market accounts at slot 463315483 and the Clock of that slot (program at 8af1e70c), picked to cover the cases named in picked; each owner is replaced by a dummy key and the bump and address re-derived from it; the synthetic entries are copies with a 1e36 size, which makes each unit of an amount per size worth 1e6 token units; prices are Arbitrum keeper tickers through the mint table; expected values come from gmsol at 8af1e70c: the Position read with its declare_program type, the address from Pubkey::find_program_address, and pending_borrowing_fee_value and pending_funding_fees of a PositionModel on the market advanced to the Clock time as update_fees_state does (borrowing, then funding)

mainnet Order, UserHeader and Store accounts of store CTDLvGGXnoxvqLyTpGzdGLg9pD6JexKxKXSV8tqqo8bN at slot 462111896 (program at 8af1e70c), one order per kind and action state plus the edge cases named in picked; wallet-derived keys are replaced by dummy keys, and the last order is a synthetic copy with a u128::MAX size; expected values come from gmsol-programs at 8af1e70c (its declare_program types and Store::order_fee_discount_factor)
